spells.notes: Kim Young-sam-era holdover in office on 1998-02-25. Appointed in the 1997-08-05 reshuffle (문화일보 1997-08-06: '김영삼 대통령은 5일 오후 개각을 단행, ... 교육부장관에 이명현 서울대교수, ... 각각 임명했다'). The MOE page and ko.wikipedia give 1997-08-06, probably the 임명장/취임 date, which cannot be checked in the 관보 because there are no digital files before 2001. End set to the 1998-03-03 appointment of the Kim Dae-jung cabinet (same-day handover); the MOE page lists 1998-03-02. Birth date from ko.wikipedia '이명현 (1942년)' revid 41473420 https://ko.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=41473420 [snapshot roster/sources/education/wiki/kowiki_bio_이명현_(1942년).json; accessed 2026-09-25T13:33:17-0400] (secondary). [verifier] Start changed from 1997-08-05 (announcement) to 1997-08-06, the day the 임명장 were given (연합뉴스 1997-08-06, 서울신문 1997-08-07) and the date in the contemporaneous 2000 edition of the ministry list. In the gazette era the printed appointment date usually equals the 임명장 day (for example 윤덕홍, named 2003-03-06 evening, 관보 2003-03-07, and 이기준, named 2005-01-04, 임명장 and 관보 2005-01-05), but not always (박순애, 재가 and 관보 2022-07-04, 임명장 2022-07-05), so the value is disputed.

issues.desc: The MOE 역대 장관 page (moe.go.kr/mnstrHistory.do) differs from the 관보 or same-day news for these spells: 김신일 start (MOE 2006-08-09, 관보 2006-09-20) and end (MOE 2008-02-28, 사표 수리 2008-02-05); 이상주 end (MOE 2003-03-05, 이임식 2003-03-07); 이기준 end (MOE 01-10, 수리 01-09); 김병준 end (MOE 08-08, 수리 08-07); 송자 end (MOE 08-29, 수리 08-30); 문용린 start/end (MOE 01-14/08-05, news 01-13/08-07); 김상곤 start (MOE 07-05 취임식, 관보 07-04); 박순애 start (MOE 07-05, 관보 07-04); 이주호 end (MOE 2025-07-28, 사임 재가 2025-07-29). The MOE page also marks predecessors as leaving the day before the successor's start where the day's news shows a same-day handover (이해찬, 한완상, 김진표, 김도연, 이주호 2013). The MOE page has no entry for 최교진.

Two appointments in this lineage are absent from the 관보 index and the harvested corpus: 한완상 (2001-01-29 reshuffle, known gap) and 안병만 (2008-08-06, together with 장태평 and 전재희). Their start dates rest on news of the day (tier 3) plus the MOE page (tier 2).

이주호 (2nd spell) end date 2025-07-29 rests on news reporting that 교육부 announced the 사임 재가 on 2025-07-29; the MOE page says 2025-07-28. No 관보 exit notice exists. If the 재가 was signed on 2025-07-28 and announced the next day, the end would move by one day.

Naver search began returning a block page ('검색 서비스 이용이 제한되었습니다') to this network around 2026-09-25 13:28 EDT during this run. The block pages were saved as SERP snapshots (flagged blocked=true in roster/sources/education/news/serp/serp_hits.json, not cited) and are also in the shared request cache under tools/cache/search.naver.com for those query keys, so reruns of the same queries need refresh=True. Later checks used BigKinds metadata instead.

황우여 and 최교진 are each split into two spells where the office title changed by law without a change of ministry name (부총리 겸임 added 2014-11-19, removed 2025-10-01), so that deputy_pm is constant within a spell. reorg_continuation=true marks the second spell. 최교진 received a new appointment notice dated 2025-10-01; no notice was found for 황우여 in 2014-11/12.

이돈희 (교육부) ends 2001-01-28, the last day of the name 교육부. The renaming law and his successor's appointment both took effect on 2001-01-29, and he was replaced, so no continuation spell in 교육인적자원부 was created.

[verifier] 서남수 (교육부) end corrected from 2014-08-07 (moe.go.kr) to 2014-07-17, the day his 면직 was approved and his 이임식 held (연합뉴스, 뉴시스, 한국일보 2014-07-17). The ministry was vacant 2014-07-18..2014-08-07 under vice minister 나승일 as 직무대리.
안병영 end 2005-01-04 (MOE page, 이임 remarks reported in 중앙일보 dated 2005-01-04); the successor was named 2005-01-04 and appointed 2005-01-05, so 2005-01-05 is also possible.

Pre-2001 spells (이명현, 이해찬, 김덕중, 문용린, 송자, 이돈희) have no 관보 files; dates rest on same-day news (BigKinds metadata, Naver-hosted articles) and the MOE page. 이명현's start is set to the 1997-08-05 reshuffle day reported by the press; the MOE page and ko.wikipedia give 1997-08-06.

Acting heads 이종서 (2006) and 최은옥 (2025) are inferred from their being the sitting 차관 during the vacancy (정부조직법 제7조②: '그 기관의 장이 사고로 직무를 수행할 수 없으면 그 직무를 대행한다', wording checked in the version effective 2025-10-01, _rebuild/inventory_sources/law_go_kr/govorg/text_20251001_276049.json; earlier versions not re-read) plus reports that the ministry was run by the vice minister; no article using the phrase '장관 직무대행' with their names was found. The other acting entries are supported by transcripts or news that name the vice minister as 직무대행.
윤덕홍's hanja is printed 尹德弘 in the 관보 and 尹悳弘 (variant) on the MOE page; 김진표 is 金振杓 in the 관보 and NA record but 金鎭杓 in ko.wikipedia. The roster uses the 관보 form.

The 이주호 acting roles (대통령 권한대행 2025-05-02..06-04, 국무총리 직무대행 2025-05-02..07-03) are listed under acting for reference only. They are not vacancies of 교육부; the pm lineage is the authority for those dates.
[verifier] Day-level continuity recomputed, see the continuity object (7 vacancies, all with an acting vice minister).

Persons speaking as education minister in valid-type transcript meetings who are not in the roster: 김명수 (교육부장관후보자 김명수, 2014-07-09..2014-07-10, 2 meetings); 나승일 (교육부장관직무대리 나승일, 2014-08-08..2014-08-08, 1 meetings); 서범석 (부총리겸교육인적자원부차관 서범석, 2003-11-04..2003-11-04, 1 meetings); 안명만 (교육과학기술부장관 안명만, 2010-01-08..2010-01-08, 1 meetings); 장상윤 (교육부장관직무대행 장상윤, 2022-05-17..2022-10-21, 7 meetings). 김명수 is the withdrawn 2014 nominee (his hearing, see nominations); 장상윤 and 나승일 are vice ministers acting as minister (listed under acting); 서범석 is a vice minister with one procedural line in 2003-11-04 while 윤덕홍 was in office; 안명만 is a one-speech transcript typo for 안병만 on 2010-01-08, inside 안병만's spell.

coverage_gaps.csv leads for this lineage are resolved: 문용린, 이돈희, 한완상, 이상주 (absent from the old panel) are now spells; 김신일, 이준식, 김상곤, 유은혜 and 이주호 off-spell rows come only from 국회본회의, 예산결산특별위원회 and 국정조사 meetings whose dates are unreliable and were ignored; 서남수's 2013-03-19 row labelled 교육과학기술부 falls inside his 교육과학기술부 spell; 이진숙 (withdrawn nominee) and 최교진 (after the transcript window) are handled as a nomination and a spell.

[verifier] Pre-2001 start dates of the 8·5 (1997) and 1·13 (2000) reshuffles are disputed between the announcement day and the 임명장 day. 이명현 and 문용린 now follow the 임명장 day (1997-08-06, 2000-01-14), which is the date in the contemporaneous ministry lists and the one most other lineages use. 김덕중's end moved with 문용린's start. No 관보 file exists before 2001.

[verifier] The moe.go.kr 역대 장관 page is also wrong for 서남수's end (2014-08-07 instead of 2014-07-17). The 2000, 2005 and 2012 editions of the ministry's own lists (Internet Archive) agree with the roster on every name and on most dates. Where they differ, they use the successor's start as the 퇴임일자.
